[LREG.3.1] A pattern's parentheses fall into three states:

| Form | Captures? | Binding |
|---|---|---|
| `(?<name>...)` | yes | named, position-bound, name must match the binding-form slot at that position |
| `(...)` | yes | positional, the binding-form slot at that position takes the author's chosen identifier |
| `(?:...)` | no | grouping only; absent from the binding form |
